solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Refuse what can be earned around London?

parts.note: SE, the South East, is the region of England surrounding London
a wage is the pay a worker earns

explanation.surface: A question about where people can make money in the area around the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' looks like a containment signal, but 'around London' just names SE, the South East region of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Refuse in the sense of waste matter; sewage is liquid waste carried off in drains.

clue.text: Hold arm up in tube? That may be going to work

definitions.text: Hold arm up in tube? That may be going to work

parts.words: Hold arm up in tube? That may be going to work
parts.note: a commuter standing in a crowded Underground carriage holds an overhead strap with a raised arm on the way to the office

explanation.surface: A puzzle over raising an arm in a tube, as if doing a medical test or exercise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tube' suggests a pipe or test tube; it is the London Underground, known as the Tube.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing passengers on a train grip a hanging strap, which is what straphanging commuters do daily.

clue.text: What bird is doing we misrepresented?

indicators.note: to misrepresent something is to present it wrongly, so the letters of the words doing we are presented in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone asks which bird a group's activity has been wrongly portrayed as.
explanation.definitionFit: The widgeon is a freshwater duck, so it names a kind of bird.

clue.text: Grand forest that may surround the house

parts.note: G is the standard abbreviation for grand, a thousand pounds
the Forest of Arden is the English woodland setting of As You Like It

explanation.surface: A great forest encircling a dwelling.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot of cultivated land often lies all around a home, front and back.

clue.text: Serene, though surrounded by endless pack ice

indicators.note: the word for though sits inside the trimmed pack and ice, which enclose it
each of the two words pack and ice loses its final letter

parts.note: floating sea ice packed together
if can mean though, as in 'nice, if a bit dull'

explanation.surface: Calm despite being hemmed in by drifting polar ice.
explanation.walkthrough: The one indicator 'endless' trims both words of 'pack ice', not just the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Pacific means peaceful and calm, a synonym for serene.

clue.text: Bill has no time for puzzle

indicators.note: the word for bill is left lacking the letter for time

parts.note: a bill is a poster stuck on a wall, as in 'stick no bills'

explanation.surface: Someone named Bill is too busy to do a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' reads as a man's name; it is a printed notice.
explanation.definitionFit: A poser is a baffling question or problem, a synonym of puzzle as a noun.

clue.text: Phone feature defective — nothing working in the country

indicators.note: defective means lacking something, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: most mobile phones have a built-in camera
O is the figure zero, nothing
on means working or operating, as a switched-on machine

explanation.surface: A faulty phone camera means nothing is working anywhere in the land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'defective' trims CAMERA to CAMER.
explanation.definitionFit: Cameroon is a nation in Central Africa, so it is a country.

clue.text: Like a bit of fish, being European

definitions.text: Like a bit of fish, being European

parts.words: Like a bit of fish, being European
parts.note: a pun: resembling a fin would be fin-ish, which sounds just like the word for a native of Finland

explanation.surface: Something that resembles a piece of fish and comes from Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: There is no exact letter-by-letter wordplay: the clue rests on fin-ish (like a fin) sounding the same as the nationality.
explanation.definitionFit: A Finnish person comes from Finland, a Nordic nation of Europe.

clue.text: Cut right through hollow

indicators.note: the letter for right goes through, into the middle of, the word for hollow

parts.note: a cave is a hollow in rock or a hillside

explanation.surface: Slicing straight through a hollow object.
explanation.definitionFit: To carve is to cut, especially to slice meat or shape wood or stone.

clue.text: Plant endlessly lucrative when propagated

indicators.note: propagating a plant breeds new growth from it, here suggesting the letters regrow in a new order
the word lucrative loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Raising a plant is endlessly profitable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' drops the final E of LUCRATIVE; 'propagated' rearranges the remaining LUCRATIV.
explanation.definitionFit: A cultivar is a plant variety bred and kept in cultivation by gardeners.

clue.text: Traveller is author with American accent, speaking?

indicators.note: said with an American accent, where the middle t is softened towards a d sound

parts.note: a writer is an author

explanation.surface: A traveller is described as an American-accented author talking.
explanation.walkthrough: In much American speech the T in WRITER is flapped, so it is said much like RIDER.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider travels on horseback, a bicycle or as a passenger, so is a traveller.

clue.text: Melting in our arms — that's only seen at night

indicators.note: melting breaks down a form, so the letters of in our arms are reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: A romantic moment of melting in each other's arms.
explanation.definitionFit: The Little Bear constellation is a group of stars, visible only in darkness.

clue.text: Cleric who's left briefly, late coming in

indicators.note: the word for late arrives inside the shortened word for left
briefly means cut short, so the word loses its last letter

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
recent can mean late, as in 'the late news'

explanation.surface: A clergyman who departed for a short while and returned late.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' is the nautical side, port, not a past tense of leave; the insertion goes just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A precentor is a priest or minister who leads the singing in a cathedral or church.

clue.text: River runs within explosive borders

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: the letters for explosive form the borders on either side of the word for within

parts.note: HE stands for high explosive
in means within

explanation.surface: A river flows between dangerous, explosive frontiers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rhine is a major European waterway flowing from Switzerland to the North Sea.

clue.text: River: one among a number

indicators.note: the letter for river is placed among the letters of a and the word for number

explanation.surface: A river described as just one of many.
explanation.walkthrough: 'River' does double duty: it is the definition and also gives R, which sits inside A NO. The answer is indeed one river among many.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arno is the Italian river flowing through Florence and Pisa, one of a great many rivers.

clue.text: Alternate energy, extremely different

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
very means extremely
other means different, as in 'some other time'

explanation.surface: Switching between power sources that are wildly unlike each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Alternate as in alternate days means skipping one each time, so each second one.

clue.text: Circle character that calls for an answer

parts.note: a ring is a circle
tone can mean character or general quality, as in the tone of a place

explanation.surface: A personality trait in a social circle that demands a reply.
explanation.definitionFit: A mobile's ringtone sounds on an incoming call, prompting the owner to pick up and respond.

clue.text: New student joins part of army course

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is a corps of the British Army
a fresher is a first-year student at a British university

explanation.surface: A newly arrived student signs up to a section of the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: A refresher is a short course of training that updates someone's skills.

clue.text: Bone half upright on bare ground

indicators.note: only the first half of the word for upright is used

parts.note: vertical means upright

indicators.note: ground means crushed or milled, so the letters of bare are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A bone stands half upright on bare earth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' takes VERT from VERTICAL; 'ground' rearranges BARE to EBRA. 'ground' looks like soil but is the past tense of grind.
explanation.definitionFit: A vertebra is one of the small bones that make up the spine.

clue.text: Religious medal if dear must be changed to be accepted

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are taken in, held inside the word for medal

parts.note: gong is British slang for a medal or award

indicators.note: the letters of if dear are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A medal's inscription has to be altered before it is acceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'medal' is not anagram fodder: it gives the slang word that holds the shuffled 'if dear'.
explanation.definitionFit: A god-fearing person is devout and earnestly religious.

clue.text: Big band arrangement is briefly touching

indicators.note: a musical arrangement reworks a piece, here the letters of big band are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A big band's arrangement is briefly moving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' looks musical, fitting the big band, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Dabbing means pressing lightly and briefly, as with a cloth on a stain.

clue.text: A revolutionary force in the kitchen?

definitions.text: A revolutionary force in the kitchen?

parts.note: Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: Someone who transforms the kitchen like a revolutionary leader.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay is the first three words; the whole clue then describes a cook who runs the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A head cook commands the kitchen, so is its driving force.

clue.text: Direction from husband say, stifling a row

indicators.note: the letters for say smother the a and the word for row by surrounding them

parts.note: EG, for example, is signalled by say
a din is a noisy row or racket

explanation.surface: A husband gives instructions while suppressing an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' is a noisy quarrel here, rhyming with now, not a line.
explanation.definitionFit: A heading is the compass direction a ship or aircraft is pointing.

clue.text: A haughty type turns up one miniature

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up means reading the words a haughty type from bottom to top

parts.note: a snob is a haughty, superior person
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A haughty person arrives as a small figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reverses A SNOB to BONSA.
explanation.definitionFit: Bonsai are trees kept tiny by pruning, so the word can mean a miniature tree.

clue.text: Inoculation to back? It should be on one's front

definitions.text: It should be on one's front

parts.note: a jab is an injection or inoculation

indicators.note: back means the word to is written in reverse

explanation.surface: A vaccination given in the back, though it should go in the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A jabot is a frill of lace worn at the neck and chest of a shirt.

clue.text: Judge a horse and a sheep

parts.note: a cob is a sturdy short-legged horse

explanation.surface: A judge at an agricultural show assesses a horse and a sheep.
explanation.definitionFit: The Jacob is a piebald, many-horned breed of domestic sheep.

clue.text: Explanation of desert island having left half missing

parts.note: to rat is to desert, as a rat deserts a sinking ship
Iona is a Hebridean island off the west coast of Scotland

indicators.note: the word left loses its last two letters, half of it

explanation.surface: Accounting for a desert island that has lost half its left side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' looks like a noun before 'island' but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A rationale is the reasoning behind something, an account of why.

clue.text: Capacious jumper, wow!

parts.note: roo, short for kangaroo, is an animal that jumps
my! is an exclamation of surprise, like wow!

explanation.surface: An exclamation at how roomy a knitted sweater is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumper' looks like a British sweater; it is a kangaroo.
explanation.definitionFit: Roomy means having plenty of space inside, so ample and spacious.

clue.text: Apology as starter of chicken leg having feathers on

indicators.note: the starter of a word is its first letter, taken here from chicken

parts.note: a leg is a limb
down is the soft fine feathers of a bird

explanation.surface: A chicken dish is offered, as if a menu starter of feathered leg.
explanation.definitionFit: A climb-down is a retreat from a position, an admission of being wrong.

clue.text: Genevan, maybe, when drunken, is smart

indicators.note: a drunkard slurs a hissed s into a sh sound, so the end of the word changes

parts.note: someone from Geneva is an example of a Swiss person

explanation.surface: A citizen of Geneva who drinks is said to be well turned out.
explanation.walkthrough: A drunk's slur turns the final S sound of SWISS into SH.
explanation.definitionFit: Swish is informal for fashionable and smart, as in a swish hotel.

clue.text: Homeless person delighted to be in side ward

indicators.note: the word for delighted is put in the word for side ward

parts.note: in a hospital a bay is a small side area of beds off the main ward
glad means delighted

explanation.surface: A patient is pleased to be put in a small ward of their own.
explanation.definitionFit: A bag lady is a woman living rough who carries her possessions in bags.

clue.text: Staging erotic content, hot stuff

indicators.note: content as in what something contains, so the letters sit inside staging erotic

explanation.surface: Putting on racy material is hot stuff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' reads as material in a show but means contained letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ginger is a pungent spice with a hot taste.
